purpose: Classify imported VoiceOver fixtures before using them as exact engine contracts.

statusDefinitions.trusted: Use as an exact corpus gate. VoiceOver output, rendered HTML, and AX context agree.
statusDefinitions.refined: Use as an exact corpus gate after documented correction of capture noise.
statusDefinitions.candidate: Useful for engine development, but not yet an exact gate.
statusDefinitions.partial: Useful only for documented regions or slices.
statusDefinitions.skip: Do not use for engine gating until manually reworked.
